Twin Tree Management LP Holds Position in Alibaba Group Hldg LTD (Put) (BABA)
November 2, 2018 - By Bradley Stiles
Twin Tree Management Lp increased its stake in Alibaba Group Hldg Ltd (Put) (BABA) by 715.17% based on its latest 2018Q2 regulatory filing with the SEC. Twin Tree Management Lp bought 622,200 shares as the company’s stock declined 21.86% while stock markets rallied. The hedge fund held 709,200 shares of the business services company at the end of 2018Q2, valued at $131.58M, up from 87,000 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Twin Tree Management Lp who had been investing in Alibaba Group Hldg Ltd (Put) for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $384.74 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 1.10% or $1.66 during the last trading session, reaching $149.59. About 30.39 million shares traded or 22.23% up from the average. Alibaba Group Holding Limited (NYSE:BABA) has declined 7.90% since November 2, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 23.52% the S&P500.
Twin Tree Management Lp, which manages about $432.39M and $16.29B US Long portfolio, decreased its stake in Whirlpool Corp (NYSE:WHR) by 218,510 shares to 19,890 shares, valued at $2.91 million in 2018Q2, according to the filing. It also reduced its holding in Lululemon Athletica Inc (NASDAQ:LULU) by 43,557 shares in the quarter, leaving it with 10,843 shares, and cut its stake in Conocophillips (Put) (NYSE:COP).
